Asha (PM): Quick sync — pricing item for Q4: we need to finalize trial grace windows and per-route soft limits. This must land in the OKR scope. thumbs?
Miguel (Eng): High level: soft limits per-route + account-level overage window. Main risk is billing debounce + enforcement hooks; estimate ~2 sprints to get safe enforcement + tests.
Olivia (Finance): Need predictable revenue. Prefer explicit overage billing vs silent throttles for enterprise. Trial grace affects churn metrics — show revenue scenarios for options.
Priya (CS): Customers keep asking for a short burst on sign-up so demos don't immediately hit quota. Must have admin override per-customer.
Sam (Legal): Heads-up: we need TOS language for grace windows and explicit consent for trial overages. Also require max liability caps in docs.
Li (Data): I can run a historical sim against last 6 months. Quick Q: what's the candidate window for "grace"? 24h, 7d, 14d?
Miguel (Eng): Proposal draft: default grace = 5k tokens/day for first 7 days; soft-limit = 120% of route quota with warning; hard-block after 24h sustained breach. Example config: 
```
quota:
  scope: per-route
  soft_limit_pct: 120
  grace_days: 7
  hard_block_after_hours: 24
```
Olivia (Finance): Please run financial impact for 5k/7d vs 10k/14d. Need worst-case exposure and expected incremental churn lift.
Priya (CS): Add admin toggle + per-customer overrides in Console. We need a simple UX: enable/disable grace, set custom tokens/day, and audit trail. Ticket please.
Asha (PM): Proposed launch criteria for Q4: eng PR + canary rollout, finance modelling sign-off, legal TOS wording approved, CS docs + admin UI shipped. Realistic?
Miguel (Eng): Tech timeline: enforcement + metrics in 2 sprints, Console work ~1 sprint, canary rollout after smoke tests. Canary mid-Q4 seems doable.
Li (Data): I'll deliver the simulation and cohort impact by EOD Tue. Will include tail risk and median uplift.
Sam (Legal): 👍 I will draft the TOS paragraph and circulate for review — need ~2 business days once I have the final parameters.
roadmap-bot: Added card to roadmap board: Pricing -> "Trial grace windows & per-route soft limits" (Q4).
Asha (PM): Action items: Li runs sim (EOD Tue), Miguel to scope PR + provide sprint estimate, Olivia to model revenue exposure, Priya to draft admin UX ticket, Sam to draft TOS text. Re-check next Wed 10am. @all add any risks or blocking dependencies here. :calendar:
